$description: Maps scope tokens (added by ds init when maps is enabled). Pins and clusters are drawn by the app (HTML/SVG overlays), not by the map tile provider, so they are pair-checked on color.bg.surface (3:1, WCAG 1.4.11) with their labels at 4.5:1. State is never color alone: selected = larger + ring + check, visited = check glyph + text. Tiles are third-party and not guaranteed; pins carry an outline of color.bg.surface to separate them from any tile. Dark theme only: provider tiles are themed by the provider; high-contrast inherits these light values (all pass on the white high-contrast surface).

default.$description: Default pin; 6.7:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff); 6.7:1 with pin.fg. Always a circle with the place label or glyph.

selected.$description: Selected pin; 6.47:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff); 6.47:1 with pin.fg. Also larger, with a ring and a check glyph; aria-pressed.

visited.$description: Visited pin; 7.1:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff); 7.1:1 with pin.fg. Also a different glyph (check mark) and the text Visited.

fg.$description: Label or glyph on any pin; 6.47:1 minimum across the three pin backgrounds.

route.$description: Route line; 5.36:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff). Dashed or labelled by mode as well as colored.

bg.$description: Cluster bubble background; 10.36:1 with cluster.fg; 10.36:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff).
